mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES stays near -19% while TRANSIT remains around -26% to -28%, then commuting-linked discretionary visits stay suppressed and RETAIL_REC will remain below its prior 4-week average over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-4-week mean for most of the next 28 days while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain within 5 points of their current levels.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS is above +40% and GROCERY_PHARM stays slightly positive, outdoor and errand-oriented substitution keeps leisure shopping weak, so RETAIL_REC moves lower within 1 to 2 weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 14 days despite PARKS staying above 40 and GROCERY_PHARM staying at or above zero.

mechanism_narrative: A renewed downward break in TRANSIT of more than 3 points week-on-week signals tighter effective mobility constraints, and that shock lowers RETAIL_REC over the next 4 weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls more than 3 points week-on-week
failure_condition: TRANSIT posts a weekly drop greater than 3 points and RETAIL_REC does not fall below its prior 4-week mean within 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL is near +1% while WORKPLACES remains near -19%, daytime time-at-home remains elevated and shopping trips are deferred, leaving RETAIL_REC flat to weaker over the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises in the next 7 days even though RESIDENTIAL stays positive and WORKPLACES stays below -15.

mechanism_narrative: Under summer-like conditions, elevated PARKS mobility crowds out indoor shopping demand; with PARKS persistently above 45, RETAIL_REC should drift downward across the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS stays above 45 for two consecutive weekly means
failure_condition: PARKS remains above 45 for two weeks and RETAIL_REC nonetheless averages higher over the next 28 days than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GROCERY_PHARM and WORKPLACES indicates more routine, necessity-driven travel, which can spill into nearby discretionary trips and lift RETAIL_REC over the next 2 weeks.
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM and WORKPLACES both rise from their current levels, but RETAIL_REC fails to improve within 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT recovers by at least 2 points week-on-week from its current depressed level, access friction falls and retail visits rebound after a short lag, raising RETAIL_REC within 4 weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises at least 2 points week-on-week
failure_condition: TRANSIT increases by at least 2 points week-on-week and RETAIL_REC does not exceed its last-4-week mean within 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES remains suppressed while TRANSIT stays weak but PARKS rebounds, the city is still in an outdoor-substitution pattern that keeps discretionary mall and street retail demand below baseline over the next month.
failure_condition: PARKS rises while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT stay depressed, yet RETAIL_REC averages higher over the next 28 days than over the previous 28 days.
